mapper.select: SELECT m.message_id AS messageId, m.goods_id AS goodsId, m.user_id AS userId, u.username AS username, m.content AS content, m.create_time AS createTime FROM message m LEFT JOIN `user` u ON m.user_id = u.user_id WHERE m.goods_id = #{goodsId} ORDER BY m.create_time DESC, m.message_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (goods_id, user_id, content, create_time) VALUES (#{goodsId}, #{userId}, #{content}, NOW())
